name: Cyclone-4M with coast to node
description: A deliberately longer ascent profile, used to prove that T_to_inj flows through the injection-consistent solver rather than being fixed inside it. Not a separate vehicle: it is the same Cyclone-4M flown with the coast phase of spec II.5 enabled.
t_to_inj_source: ASSUMPTION. A 30 minute ascent to injection, taken from the class-level coast-to-node range of 30 to 120 min recorded in spec II.5 (SCIENCE Sec A.6). The Cyclone-4M guide does not publish a coast profile, so this row exists as a sensitivity case, not as a published configuration.

ascent_profile.source: Cyclone-4M Abbreviated User's Guide section 2.5.2 Table 2.2 for the ascent phases; the coast phase is assumed.

hazard_footprint.source: Inherited unchanged from cyclone4m.json; a longer coast extends downrange but no published figure covers it.

rows.source: Not published. Class-level coast-to-node range from spec II.5; see t_to_inj_source.
No coast profile is published for this vehicle.
